pdf-page-splitter/features/local: Everything runs in your browser — your PDF never leaves your device.
pdf-page-splitter/features/modes: Horizontal and vertical cuts with a draggable, per-page cut line.
pdf-page-splitter/features/per_page: Set the cut direction, cut line, and rotation independently for each page.
pdf-page-splitter/features/vector: Exports keep the original text and vector content instead of rasterizing pages.
pdf-page-splitter/how_to_use/step1: Click the upload area and choose a PDF file (you can also drop or paste it).
pdf-page-splitter/how_to_use/step2: Choose a cut direction in the preview: horizontally for top/bottom pages or vertically for left/right pages.
pdf-page-splitter/how_to_use/step3: Drag the blue cut line to fine-tune the split position, and use the rotate buttons if the page is sideways.
pdf-page-splitter/how_to_use/step4: Use the batch settings to apply the same cut to every page, then adjust individual pages as needed.
pdf-page-splitter/how_to_use/step5: Download a single PDF with all pages, or a ZIP with one PDF per page.
pdf-page-splitter/note: Split PDF pages horizontally or vertically, fine-tune the cut line on each page, rotate pages, and export a new PDF or a ZIP — everything happens in your browser.
pdf-page-splitter/settings/apply_mode_al: Apply cut direction to all pages
pdf-page-splitter/settings/apply_positio: Apply cut position to all pages
pdf-page-splitter/settings/hint: These actions apply to every page. You can still fine-tune each page in the preview.
